messages.content: 1800年英格蘭的國王全名是什麼？

function.name: monarch_getMonarchOfYear
function.description: Retrieve the monarch of a specific location during a specified year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location (e.g., country) whose monarch needs to be found.

year.description: The year to search the monarch.

fullName.description: If true, returns the full name and title of the monarch.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function monarch_getMonarchOfYear with location "England" or "United Kingdom"? The user asks "1800年英格蘭的國王全名是什麼？" So we should provide the full name and title. In 1800, England was part of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland? Actually the UK formed in 1707 as Great Britain; then 1801 it became United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. So in 1800, the monarch was King George III. Full name: George William Frederick. Title: His Majesty King George III of Great Britain and Ireland? Wait at that time, he was King of Great Britain and Ireland? He had been king since 1760. But the official title before 1801 was King of Great Britain. After 1801, King of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. So in 1800, his title would be "His Majesty King George III of Great Britain". But the user might want the full name and title. So we can say: "George William Frederick, His Majesty King George III of Great Britain." Let's use the function.

We'll call monarch_getMonarchOfYear with location "England", year 1800, fullName true.
